non_blocking_observations: World-space signage close to the camera can extend outside the frame; principal HUD panels remain readable.
The pale stair prompt has variable contrast over yellow step edges; the separate dark route panel remains readable.
The help screenshot shows the initial scroll position; the lower content is outside the still and is accessed through the visible scroll control.
Procedural character, hand and descender geometry is prototype art, not final production animation.
limitations: Prepared states and sampled clocks do not establish a complete human playthrough or transition-video review.
Linux native images do not certify Windows execution, browser WebGL/WebAssembly, performance, voice acting or audible mix quality.
